branch.description: Default git reference for `--diff` and `--diff-only`. An empty string disables the diff.

staged.description: Compare staged changes by default, like `--staged`.

LspSection.description: Settings for the `complexipy lsp` language server.

diagnostic-range.description: What the warning underlines: `name` the function name only, `function` the whole function.

diagnostics.description: Publish a warning for every function above `max-complexity-allowed`.

hover.description: Where hover answers: `signature` on the `def` lines only, `function` on any line of the function, `never` for no hover.

inlay-hints.description: When to show the per-function hint: `threshold` only above `max-complexity-allowed`, `always` for every function, `never` for no hint.

per-line-hints.description: Also show the complexity added by each line, as `+2`. Lines that add nothing are skipped.

workspace-diagnostics.description: Also publish warnings for files that are not open, from a scan of the workspace folder.

description: Configuration for complexipy, read from complexipy.toml, .complexipy.toml, or [tool.complexipy] in pyproject.toml.

cache-dir.description: Directory for the analysis cache. Defaults to `.complexipy_cache/` in the invocation directory.

check-script.description: Report module-level (script) complexity as a synthetic `<module>` entry.

exclude.description: Glob patterns of files to skip, such as `tests/**`.

failed.description: Show only functions above the complexity threshold.

force-exclude.description: Apply `exclude` to files passed explicitly as arguments, such as the file names pre-commit passes.

ignore.description: Never report these refactoring rules or rule groups, such as `C007` or `readability`. Wins over `select`.

ignore-complexity.description: Do not exit with an error when the threshold is breached.

max-complexity-allowed.description: Functions strictly above this complexity are reported. A function at the limit passes.

no-ignore.description: Analyze every function, disregarding inline ignore comments.

output.description: File or directory for machine-readable output. Use a directory when writing more than one format.

report-ignored.description: List every file and line where an ignore comment suppresses a function.

select.description: Report only these refactoring rules or rule groups, such as `C001` or `complexity`.

snapshot-create.description: Save the current violations above the threshold into `complexipy-snapshot.json`.

snapshot-ignore.description: Skip comparing against the snapshot even if it exists.

title: complexipy
